description: The other half of the 2026-08-27 report: a Leap to Defend whose 2D6 IS enough. The counter-charge roll was equally invisible here — ChargeController._on_dice_rolled dropped the 'heroic_intervention_charge_roll' context, so the only thing that happened on screen was the charge tools quietly turning on, with no dice and no number. This drives the real Leap to Defend button on a unit 5" from the Warboss that charged this turn, and asserts the seeded 2D6 = 8 is reported to the player (dice log + Game Log) alongside the movement prompt it unlocks.

steps.comment: 5 inches edge-to-edge: a seeded 2D6 = 8 comfortably clears the ~3 inch gap to engagement range

steps.script:
var d = tree.current_scene._phase_end_confirm
if d != null and d.visible:
	d.get_ok_button().pressed.emit()
return true

steps.comment: at 5 inches BOTH modes have a target, so neither button is greyed — the disable only hides modes that cannot resolve
the charge stands and the phase is holding open for the counter-charge move

THE BUG: the counter-charge 2D6 never reached the dice log, because _on_dice_rolled dropped every context that was not 'charge_roll'. The Charge phase is still running here, so the dice log survives to be read.
and the Game Log carries the same roll, so it is still readable once the phase moves on
the movement prompt keeps the rolled distance: _update_button_states used to overwrite it with a generic line the instant any affordance changed, so the number vanished off screen
steps.equals: Heroic Intervention! Rolled 8" — use UI to move models into engagement range
